6808.title: Pi assistant stream boundary retention
6808.rootCauseOneLine: An unclosed assistant stream shares its channel and item ID with the next message; successful closure then replaces the prior accumulated text.
6808.proposedFix: Replay the real Pi boundary and recovery events first; if a legitimate next start leaves prior text open, settle accumulated text before admitting the next assistant message.
6808.caveats: Both clean checkouts reproduce only injected missing/aborted/error boundaries. Normal successful message-end control passes. Actual Pi steering, recovery lifecycle, persisted timeline, and GUI were not reproduced; no safe production PR was opened.
